framework: National Core Arts Standards - Visual Arts
subject: Arts
attribution: National Coalition for Core Arts Standards (NCCAS). National Core Arts Standards. Dover, DE: State Education Agency Directors of Arts Education, 2014.
textFidelity: Performance standard codes are verbatim and follow the official NCAS coding convention. Text is faithful to the published performance standards; longer standards are abridged for display in a mastery map. Verify against the source URL before any public-facing use.
note: NCAS publishes performance standards grade by grade for PreK-8, then at three proficiency levels for high school rather than by grade, recognizing that high school arts coursework is not organized by grade. Those levels map to the course sequence as follows: Art I and Art II to HS Proficient (HSI), Art III to HS Accomplished (HSII), and Art IV to HS Advanced (HSIII). Because Art I and Art II share the Proficient level, the level's standards are split between them by artistic process so neither course repeats the other. The four artistic processes are Creating (Cr), Presenting (Pr), Responding (Re), and Connecting (Cn).
